judgment.explanation: The draft is an unsent customer-choice request to Vessa Lorne on the customer portal. That is the order-linked thread she asked for in event-002, so the recipient and channel are supported. It asks for confirmation rather than rescheduling on its own, which respects consent. The slot it offers (2026-02-03 15:00–18:00) is real and matches the inventory in event-001. The main flaw is that it omits the second available option, 2026-02-04 10:00–13:00. The customer needs both options to choose, and a yes/no on one slot hides the alternative and her ability to pick it. It also leaves out the timezone (event-001 gives UTC) and does not mention that rescheduling is free. These omissions leave the request materially incomplete, though it is still clear and the step is routine. Whether Vessa has authority over the delivery, since the email was addressed to Iona Quill, is a minor ambiguity left unaddressed.
